item.title: Maersk, Eurogate Plan €1 Billion Bet on Zero-Emission Bremerhaven Container Hub
item.description: Maersk and Eurogate are in advanced talks on a €1 billion investment to modernize Bremerhaven’s North Sea Terminal, aiming to create Europe’s first zero-emission container hub while expanding capacity and electrifying terminal operations.

item.title: CK Hutchison Warns Maersk of Legal Action Over Panama Ports
item.description: CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd. has warned A.P. Moller-Maersk A/S of legal action should the Nordic company’s terminal unit try to take over operations at two ports near Panama’s strategic canal.

item.title: Environmental Groups Urge IMO: Keep Ammonia Waste Out of the Ocean
item.description: A coalition of environmental and clean-shipping groups is urging the International Maritime Organization to block any move that would allow ammonia-fueled ships to discharge toxic waste at sea, warning that shipping’s push toward zero-emission fuels must not come at the expense of ocean health.

item.title: MSC Extends Dominance as Container Fleet Surpasses 7.2 Million TEU
item.description: Geneva-based Mediterranean Shipping Company has reached a new milestone, pushing its total containership capacity past 7.2 million TEU and solidifying its position as the world’s largest carrier with a commanding...

item.title: Denmark Records 292 Russian ‘Shadow Fleet’ Tankers Passing Through Danish Straits
item.description: New data compiled by the Danish Maritime Authority reveals that EU-sanctioned tankers linked to Russia’s so-called “shadow fleet” made 292 voyages through Danish territorial waters in 2025, underscoring both the strategic importance of the Danish straits as a gateway to the Baltic Sea and growing concerns among European states over maritime sanctions evasion, safety and environmental risks.

item.title: US Allows Oil Majors to Broadly Operate in Venezuela, New Energy Investments
item.description: The U.S. eased sanctions on Venezuela's energy sector on Friday, issuing two general licenses that allow global energy companies to operate oil and gas projects in the OPEC member and for other companies to negotiate contracts to bring in fresh investments.

item.title: Singapore Sends a Clear Signal as Gas Tanker Captain Jailed Over Fatal Cover-Up
item.description: xSingapore has delivered one of the clearest warnings yet to maritime professionals about the consequences of misleading authorities after a serious onboard accident, sentencing the master of a gas tanker to 14 months in jail for covering up details surrounding a fatal tank-cleaning incident.

item.title: Trump Unveils White House Maritime Action Plan to Restore U.S. Seapower
item.description: America builds under 1% of commercial ships. The White House Maritime Action Plan bets on vessel fees, a trust fund, and zones, but Congress is the clock.By Captain John Konrad...

item.title: US Refiner Valero Energy Set To Import 6.5 Million Barrels of Venezuelan Crude
item.description: Valero Energy is set to import up to 6.5 million barrels of Venezuelan crude in March, potentially surpassing Chevron as the top U.S. refiner of Venezuelan oil since sanctions began easing following the capture of President Maduro.

item.title: Japan Arrest Chinese Fishing Boat Captain
item.description: Japan seized a Chinese fishing vessel and arrested its captain after the ship entered Japan's exclusive economic zone off Nagasaki and fled inspection—the first such seizure since 2022, escalating already strained relations between the two nations.
